title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v97
author: Evan Chen
description:
Motivation: bring profiling baselines and representative workload runners into the benchmark-lab pipeline so we can consistently track perf regressions across model variants and infra changes. This PR introduces v97 of the profiling baselines and a reporting pipeline that aggregates run outputs to the central metrics backend and BigQuery dataset. Changes are backwards-compatible and gated behind a feature flag (BENCHLAB_V97).

What changed (high level): added new representative workload runners (mixed_textgen, chat_stream, embedding_bulk) with parameterized trace hooks; added profiling baselines (cold-start, steady-state, memory-breakdown) and harnesses for collecting perf counters; added a reporting pipeline DAG that normalizes runner outputs and writes summarized rows to bigquery.project.redwood.benchmark_lab.v97_runs; added CI jobs and sqs-triggered ingestion lambda; included utility scripts for converting raw traces to the canonical baseline schema.

Why now: CI has flagged intermittent regressions in adaptive batching after kernel changes; having formal baselines and a reporting pipeline allows automated regression alerts and links to the eval harness. Linked Linear tasks track rollout and alerting.

Checklist:
- [x] Add representative workload runners and unit tests
- [x] Add profiling baseline definitions and example baselines
- [x] Add reporting DAG and BigQuery write path with retries
- [x] Add feature flag and runtime gating
- [x] Add e2e integration test that runs a small sample and validates schema
- [x] Update docs and observability dashboards (dashboard PR to follow)

Notes: the BigQuery write uses the existing service-account with short-lived tokens; ingestion is idempotent via run_id dedupe. Performance-sensitive tracing is sampled by default (1%) and can be increased with BENCHLAB_TRACE_SAMPLING. Rough manual smoke numbers: mixed_textgen runner (gpt-2-small like workload) median latency stable within 5% relative to v96 on p3.2xlarge infra.

Linear: ENG-4210, ENG-4278. Related PRs: pr-503210 (v96 pipeline), pr-48901 (profiling baselines v17).
